name: Global Impact Grant
summary: Annual grants to small non-profit organisations for sea turtle conservation projects outside the continental United States, covering equipment, supplies, project travel and personnel. Multi-year projects can be funded for up to three years.

eligibility.rule: Locate the conservation project outside the continental United States
Directly support sea turtle conservation and demonstrate conservation impact
Submit any required final report before applying again if previously funded
Begin the project on or after January 1, 2027
Exclude organizational overhead, bank fees, conference travel, pass-through grants and similar indirect expenses

documents: Financial statements, preferably for two years
